description: InvoicePlane is a PHP/CodeIgniter self-hosted invoicing app: admins create clients, quotes and invoices (with line items, tax rates, discounts, per-doc passwords), send them by email/PDF, convert quotes to invoices, collect payments (manual, Stripe, PayPal) that recalculate invoice amounts and status, manage projects/tasks/products/units/families, import/export CSV, and configure everything via key/value settings; guest users with assigned clients can view and pay invoices and approve/reject quotes via public url-key links.
